source: Exact catalogue-335 viewer material behavior; no wire fields
shaderDefaults: Preserve each selected GLB's authored PBR factors, maps and vertex colors unless a rule below applies.
colors: Palette hex is sRGB; convert to linear RGB before assigning shader factors. Skin/ink/stubble/lip palette arrays are already linear.

pigments.rule: Multiply selected skin by the numeric final token in the material name.

hair.defaultAndBrownAlias: Preserve authored pigment and vertex colors.
hair.ombre: Use fitted ombre GLBs for hair/hairLengths, preserve baked vertex colors and authored groom root pigment.
hair.solidColor: For non-authored solid colors, neutralize existing vertex colors into luminance shading using material_recipes.mjs, then multiply the target linear factor by hairShade258 (default 1) and by 0.82 for groom.
hair.normalAndRoughnessMaps: Preserve for every color. Clone geometry before neutralizing shared vertex colors.

frames.tortoise: Use drawTortoise64 plus frame pigment; repeat wrapping. If UVs are absent, u=position.x*12 and v=position.y*12.
frames.roughness: Preserve Aero GLB. Do not replace lens or frame roughness indiscriminately.

lenses.alphaAndSurface: Preserve the chosen clear/dark GLB. Current finish recipe has clear alpha 0.075 and dark alpha 0.74.
lenses.warning: Alpha blending is not refraction/transmission. Do not infer glass behavior from alphaMode alone.

headgear.patternedCloth: If a pashmina/bandana material has a base-color map, dye its cool dark ground using dyeClothRgba; preserve print, weave, UV orientation and wrap modes. Set factor to white after dye.
headgear.other: Apply selected linear factor; preserve other PBR inputs.

top.jersey: Use packaged dye pattern and atlas maps. Feminine uses feminine_jersey_dyes; Masculine uses shared jersey atlases and dark front/back art for light targets with linear luminance > 0.35. Set mapped jersey factors to white.
top.protectedDetails: Preserve buttons, printing and other unmatched authored materials.

exactBrowserReference: viewer335.js functions colors, clothColor, tortoiseTexture, tint and authoredKey. Their order is significant.
blenderDifferences: Cycles studio/world, color management, disabled glossy-ray visibility on clothing and camera are scene settings rather than ordinary GLB material data.
